name: singlet_demux_donor_assignment_reference_genotypes
title: Reference-genotype donor assignment and doublet calling
description: Assigns each droplet of a pooled single-cell RNA-seq dataset to a reference donor from allele counts at informative SNPs and a donor genotype VCF, labelling singlets, cross-donor doublets, ambiguous and unassigned droplets, and matches anonymous clusters to reference individuals. Use the default vireo_gt method when every pool donor is in the VCF; demuxlet and souporcell_known are comparators. Do not use without reference genotypes or to find same-donor multiplets, which genotypes cannot separate. Writes donor_id, donor_status, donor_prob_max, donor_doublet_prob and mapping members.

dataset.description: Dataset handle: a .singlet path or URI (local path, s3://, r2://, https://) or a workspace handle.

donor_vcf.description: Reference genotype VCF covering every pool donor; required by demuxlet and souporcell_known.

method.description: Algorithm: vireo_gt (default, model-based), demuxlet, or souporcell_known (known-genotype clustering).

genotype_tag.description: VCF FORMAT tag used for donor genotype probabilities.

n_donor.description: Pool donor count; above the VCF sample count, genotypes are learned for the extra donors.

n_init.description: Random restarts used when genotypes are learned (the CLI default is 50).

prob_max_unassigned.description: Droplets whose largest donor posterior is below this value are unassigned.

doublet_prob_threshold.description: Droplets with doublet probability at or above this value are doublets.

min_informative_variants.description: Droplets covering fewer informative variants are unassigned.

beta_sum_prior.description: Concentration prior on genotype-specific allele fractions.

demuxlet.description: Options for method demuxlet (read-level likelihood over an alpha grid).

field.description: VCF FORMAT field read for genotype probabilities; GP is the popscle default.

alpha_grid.description: Second-donor RNA fractions searched for doublets; include 0 for singlets.

doublet_prior.description: Prior doublet rate; changes BEST.POSTERIOR only, not the droplet type.

margin_nats.description: Log-likelihood margin for singlet, doublet and ambiguous calls; demuxlet uses 2.

min_mapq.description: Minimum mapping quality of reads used.

geno_error_offset.description: Genotype error offset applied when loading reference genotypes; 0.10 is the popscle default.

souporcell_known.description: Options for souporcell_known; the input VCF must be uncompressed.

max_loci.description: Maximum loci per cell used for clustering.

min_alt.description: Minimum cells expressing the alternate allele for a locus to be used.

min_ref.description: Minimum cells expressing the reference allele for a locus to be used.

seed.description: Random seed for restarts and random initialisation.

dry_run.description: Return estimated time, memory and device without running.

device.description: Execution device; auto picks CUDA when a device with enough memory is available.

overwrite.description: Replace existing output members instead of failing.

dataset.description: Handle of the dataset that was (or would be) updated.

status.description: completed: ran inline and wrote members; dry_run: only an estimate was computed; queued: running as a long job (see job_id).

wrote.description: Members written, for example obs/donor_id. Empty for dry_run and queued.

summary.description: Compact summary for completed runs: status_counts, n_donors, unmatched_clusters, method_version.

provenance_id.description: Id of the provenance record appended to the dataset (null unless completed).

estimate.description: Present for dry_run: seconds, peak_memory_gb, device.
